reason: I already follow the Tawfeer offers myself and stock up when there is a deal, so why pay $2 a bag on top? My children send money each month but every dollar still counts.
objection: Another fee on top of my groceries. I can compare prices and buy the deals myself, and I would have to trust strangers to shop for me and then go out to a pickup point between 6 and 8 in the evening.
would_change_my_mind: No fee, or a fee only when the carton and bulk savings on my list clearly beat what I pay at the till, shown on the receipt.
